headline: Hawkish Fed minutes, Nvidia fades again, Anthropic debuts today; tech vol still high

what_happened.summary: Per the Cboe Daily Take 'Nasdaq Breaks Losing Streak as Dow and S&P Slide Again' (18 Nov), Nvidia opened higher after earnings but closed nearly 3% lower, while the Nasdaq Composite snapped a four-session losing streak. FRED shows the Nasdaq-100 closed at 27116.26 (+0.42%) and the S&P 500 at 7323.63 (-0.23%), its fifth straight loss per Cboe. Cboe calls a 9 Dec hike a near certainty after the October FOMC minutes, which it describes as hawkish. It also says Fed Governor Waller floated a 50-basis-point increase. Unverified headlines this morning describe Nasdaq futures rising ahead of Anthropic's debut, and others say yields are edging higher. The inputs contain no live prices, so this brief does not say where NQ trades.
what_happened.market_action: Nasdaq-100 +0.42% against S&P 500 -0.23%. Cboe reports the Dow down 1.11% (UnitedHealth -10.2% on a proposed Medicare Advantage audit expansion) and retailers up after Target and TJX results. VIX closed at 24.56 (-3.53%) and VXN at 33.12 (-3.83%), but COR1M rose to 23.24 (+15.45%), its third straight rise (9.99 on 12 Nov). VVIX was 118.37 and SKEW 142.84.
what_happened.macro: Treasury (primary source): the 10-year closed at 5.07% (-3.0 bp), the 2-year at 4.8% (0.0 bp) and the 30-year at 5.41% (-5.0 bp), so yields eased despite the hawkish tone. Polymarket (prediction-market prices, not CME FedWatch) puts a 25 bps December hike at 91.5% and a 50+ bps hike at 6.4%. FRED HY OAS was 3.43 pct pts (+9.0 bp) as of 17 Nov, the third widening in a row. Latest BLS prints: October core CPI 0.3% m/m, unemployment 4.1%.
what_happened.geopolitics: Not covered by the sources beyond Cboe's earlier mention of Middle East tanker attacks and unverified headlines about Middle East shipping risks. FRED oil is stale to 17 Nov (Brent 92.94 $/bbl, WTI 89.53 $/bbl).
what_happened.company_news: Nvidia: Cboe says its shares are down more than 30% in the last month. Its board is investigating former CEO Huang, and Cboe reports Justice and Commerce department scrutiny of Megaspeed over possible China export violations, with the SEC reportedly probing too. Cboe says options price a move of almost $23 either way. Anthropic reportedly priced its IPO at $83 per share, 825 million shares, six to seven times oversubscribed, with trading due Thursday (Cboe, citing reports). UnitedHealth fell 10.2% and Humana 13%.

driver_reason: The index divergence (Nasdaq-100 +0.42%, S&P 500 -0.23%, Dow -1.11%) came from stock-specific moves: Nvidia fading, UnitedHealth and the retailers, with Anthropic's debut next. The Fed shift is real, but yields fell on the day, so rates did not drive the tape.
leader_reason: Nasdaq-100 minus S&P 500 was +0.65 pct pts last session, but -0.55 pct pts over five sessions, so the rebound is only one day old. VXN minus VIX is 8.56 pts and COR1M is 23.24 and rising, so tech still carries the risk premium while correlation is starting to broaden.
